marketLayer.title: US Tech Giants & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology leaders continue to report elevated capital expenditure plans focused heavily on AI hardware and data center expansion.
marketLayer.inference: Upstream semiconductor design, foundry, and server supply chains maintain strong revenue visibility, anchoring long-term valuation support for US mega-cap tech.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential lag in enterprise monetization of generative AI software relative to massive infrastructure spending.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet Sector & Shareholder Yields
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech heavyweights maintain high-frequency share buyback programs alongside steady operational efficiency improvements.
marketLayer.inference: Aggressive capital return strategies establish a firm valuation bottom for Hong Kong-listed tech stocks, shifting investor attention to overall shareholder yield.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistent promotional price wars in domestic e-commerce and cloud services dampening core profit margins.

marketLayer.title: US Inflation Trajectory & Rate Outlook
marketLayer.fact: Recent US disinflation trends remain intact, keeping market pricing aligned with potential Federal Reserve rate cuts later this year.
marketLayer.inference: Easing yield pressures on US Treasuries improve global liquidity conditions and reduce discount-rate drag on high-growth and emerging market equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Resurgent energy prices or unexpected supply chain bottlenecks reigniting short-term inflationary pressure.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicles & Global Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV makers demonstrate strong export volume growth across Southeast Asia and Latin America.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerating international footprint helps top-tier domestic manufacturers mitigate domestic price competition and inventory pressures.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Escalating trade barriers, tariffs, and regulatory compliance scrutiny in overseas markets.
